notes: Borderline include. Jatropha curcas (biofuel shrub) in three modes: sole crop, intercrop with annual crops (10 rows/ha, 10 m x 1 m; English caption calls it alley cropping) and living fence (haie vive). Kept in on trees_in_farmlands (subtype alley) for the intercrop; living fence is boundary_plantings (not_taken_forward), recorded but not the reason for inclusion. Sole-crop jatropha is a plantation, not a defined practice: not extracted. All economic values are projections at full production (hypothesised yields from 2008-2012 monitoring of 24 plots plus literature) x 3 seed prices -> data_type modelled. Treatment values exist only in figures. Comparators (147 000 / 55 000 F CFA/ha; 1 400 / 750 F CFA/h.j) come from Baldet (2011) cropping-system data. Team decision needed: does jatropha alley intercropping count as trees_in_farmlands?

adoption.definition_used: plantations de jatropha répertoriées en 2009 / restantes en 2012
adoption.locator: Perspectives concernant l'évolution des systèmes de culture, paragraph 1 (left column, top)
adoption.quote: Sur 245 plantations de jatropha re´pertorie´es en 2009 dans la communaute´ rurale de Dialacoto, il n’en restait plus que 138 en 2012.
adoption.note: Count of jatropha plantations remaining (all three modes pooled: sole, intercrop, living fence), not farmers; 'number_farmers' is the nearest measure code. Practice coded other because the count mixes modes; the paper says living fences were abandoned much less than sole-crop plots (no number). context within_project is a judgement (census of plantations under the jatropha projects named in the acknowledgements).
